articles.title: Denuvo are suing a prolific cracker for bypassing their DRM on 26 videogames, despite not knowing their real identity
articles.body: Digital rights management software provider Denuvo are taking a prolific anonymous game cracker to court in the USA, accusing them of violating the Digital Millennium Copyright Act by circumventing the anti-tamper technology on 26 games, including Black Myth: Wukong, Resident Evil Requiem and Doom: The Dark Ages.
